title: Peatmoor ivyhurst sud 交易所分割计划
instruction:
您是 Peatmoor Analytics 的医疗运营经理，该公司负责管理 Ivyhurst Studios 的同一地点的初级保健实践和获得许可的药物使用障碍服务。 Estelle Calderon 需要一份准备就绪的运营计划，以便在 10 月份加入地区健康信息交换，同时又不暴露该服务视为特别保护的记录。两项服务均使用一份电子病历和一份患者病历。平台只能在遭遇层面隔离出站数据；它不能选择性地消除个体问题或药物，临床医生依赖于统一的内部药物清单。拆分图表会破坏临床观点，隔离整个实践会破坏交换承诺，而需要大量同意的模型将超出团队反复进行人工审查的能力。这种做法也正在发生变化：在接下来的八周内，SUD 服务将从共享调度模板转向专用部门和遭遇类型，而历史和已预订的遭遇将保留不一致的标签。因此，该计划必须在过渡期间以及新结构建立后发挥作用。
还有一种罕见但后果严重的情况需要涵盖：当延误可能造成严重伤害且无法获得普通同意时，另一家治疗机构可能会紧急要求昏迷患者的相关 SUD 信息。准备一个推荐的分段配置，解释材料隐私和操作边界，确定当前配置授权的更改，并预留可靠的替代方案。包括对过渡期和最终状态结果的预测背后的假设，但不要发明患者数量、人员配备水平、成本、系统功能或事实不支持的法律结论。这是行政决定，而不是法律摘要或 EHR 点击指南，并且在批准后必须可供实施和合规主管使用。最多保持四页。使用文件名`exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx`将最终文档写入工作目录的顶层。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx` — 推荐数据分段配置、定义转换和最终状态操作并记录被拒绝的替代方案的执行操作计划。 （必须使用确切的文件名exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx写入工作目录的顶层。；不得超过四个渲染页面。；必须提供一个推荐的配置并识别当前配置的授权更改。；必须解决八周过渡和最终状态。；必须解决涉及昏迷患者的罕见紧急请求。；不得发明不受支持的患者数量、人员配备水平、成本、系统功能或明确的法律结论。；不得是 EHR 点击指南。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
HIE exchange segmentation operating plan
Ivyhurst Studios  |  Decision requested: approve October configuration subject to gates below  |  Owner: Medical Operations Manager
RECOMMEND
Keep one internal chart. Use encounter-based outbound routing: eligible primary-care encounters may transmit; protected SUD encounters, mixed encounters, and unresolved encounters do not transmit routinely. Suppress outbound longitudinal medication and problem-list payloads until protected provenance can be reliably controlled.
1. Approval requested and decision boundaries
Authorize the configuration and governance changes in Section 3 for an October launch only after Compliance validates applicability and disclosure rules for the SUD program records, the HIE validates the supported feed controls, and the acceptance tests in Section 6 pass. This is an operating decision, not a legal conclusion. Qualifying SUD program records may carry heightened confidentiality protections based on program status and record provenance; licensure alone, addiction-related content alone, or placement in the shared EHR does not settle that question. A shared chart does not extinguish protections that attach to protected records.
The exchange commitment is a contractual and care-coordination objective, not independent disclosure authority. Likewise, an HIE participation agreement, notice of privacy practices, routine treatment consent, minimum-necessary review, or a technical break-glass tool does not by itself authorize disclosure of protected SUD information. Once authority exists, minimum-necessary and role controls further limit release. Recipient obligations, exchange controls, and audit trails reduce downstream risk; they cannot make improper use or redisclosure technically impossible.
2. Recommended configuration: outbound by encounter; internal chart remains unified
Content / condition
Routine HIE rule
Operating boundary
Eligible primary-care encounter
Transmit under ordinary privacy and exchange controls, unless its content or linked artifacts would reveal protected SUD treatment.
A patient’s use of the SUD service alone does not suppress otherwise eligible primary-care care.
Protected SUD encounter
Exclude by default from routine HIE release.
Release only through a validated, documented patient authorization or a narrow applicable exception.
Mixed or unresolved encounter
Hold from outbound transmission; mark restricted pending classification review/correction.
No clinician “best judgment” auto-release. A cleared, corrected encounter may be released prospectively only when authority and content are confirmed.
Longitudinal medication + problem payloads
Do not send chart-level medication-list or problem-list payloads in this configuration.
The EHR cannot segment individual problem-list or medication-list entries for exchange. Internal clinicians retain the unified medication list.
Linked artifacts and metadata
Inherit/reconcile the parent encounter restriction for orders, results, referrals, documents, notes, attachments, and routing artifacts.
Suppress revealing encounter/department names, service labels and alerts from outbound data; use neutral routing labels where needed. Identity/demographics may support matching, not disclosure of SUD participation.

3. Changes authorized from the current configuration
Approve now
Preserve / do not change
Enable encounter-level outbound routing; create a default restricted class for protected, mixed, and unresolved encounters; disable longitudinal medication and problem-list feeds; map linked artifacts and metadata to parent sensitivity; add exception queue, audit fields, role permissions, incident containment and correction workflow.
One EHR, one patient chart, and the unified internal medication list. No patient-level wall-off, chart split, problem-level filtering, medication-level filtering, or recurring manual review of every exchange transaction.
Complete the eight-week move to dedicated SUD departments and encounter types; configure them as the primary end-state routing signal. Maintain an exception path for mixed content, misclassification, and uncertain scope—labels improve reliability but do not conclusively determine legal coverage.
Existing historical and already-booked encounter labels are not treated as reliable release authority during transition.

4. Operating model: transition, end state, and exceptions
Period / pathway
Rule and accountable action
Expected qualitative outcome / assumption
Eight-week transition
For historical and already-booked encounters, validate against provenance/content mapping before release; do not use inconsistent labels as the sole basis. Unresolved before transmission remains restricted, is routed to the designated classification reviewer, and is not released until disposition. Corrected sensitivity/department classifications are approved by the classification lead; stop queued release, assess any prior transmission, preserve audit evidence, and invoke incident response when warranted.
Assumptions: labels are unreliable during staged conversion and recurring manual capacity is constrained. More holds and targeted validations are expected; routine eligible encounters continue where reliably classified.
End state
Dedicated SUD department plus encounter types route protected encounters to default exclusion. Primary-care routing remains open only when the encounter and linked artifacts pass the protected-content screen. Mixed/misclassified content follows the same restricted exception path.
More consistent routing is expected as the dedicated structure stabilizes. Residual risk remains from mixed content, incorrect assignment, and non-segmentable longitudinal data; these feeds stay suppressed.
Patient-authorized release (exception)
Release manager verifies a valid, documented authorization for the intended recipient, specific information, purpose, and duration; then releases only the authorized scope. Revalidate before each later release; stop on expiration, revocation, or material change.
Exception only—not baseline architecture—so manual work is limited to requested releases rather than every HIE event.
Urgent unconscious-patient request
Authorized clinical/privacy decision maker may use a narrow medical-emergency pathway only when relevant information is needed immediately for treatment and delay risks serious harm, ordinary permission cannot be obtained, and Compliance’s validated rule permits it. Disclose only relevant emergency information; do not automatically open the full SUD record. Technical break-glass enables access, not disclosure authority.
Promptly record emergency basis, requester/recipient, information disclosed, date/time, and authorizing actor; conduct follow-up review.

5. Alternatives set aside
Alternative
Why not the baseline (same decision tests: privacy, clinical continuity, HIE participation, capacity, technology)
Split charts
Rejected: fragments the unified medication view and introduces reconciliation and duplicate-record risk; it is disproportionate when encounter-based external controls can preserve the internal chart.
Suppress the whole practice
Rejected: over-restricts eligible primary-care exchange, undermining the participation commitment and care-coordination objective without adding a targeted safeguard.
Broad recurring consent management
Rejected: requires ongoing manual review at a level the team cannot sustain and adds expiration/revocation and routing failure points. Authorization remains available for controlled exceptions.

6. Implementation, assurance, and go-live gates
Function
Accountability and acceptance evidence
Classification & clinical validation
Clinical operations owns encounter taxonomy, mixed-content escalation, correction authority, and clinical validation. Privacy/Compliance validates scope assumptions and escalates genuinely uncertain coverage or disclosure authority; routine eligible routing does not require legal review.
Exchange configuration & privacy approval
HIE/IT configures encounter routing, linked-artifact/metadata controls, longitudinal-feed suppression, role separation, and outbound audit capture. Privacy approves exception and emergency workflow. Only designated roles may classify, override, or release protected encounters; ordinary exchange users cannot.
Pre-go-live tests
Demonstrate both permitted and prohibited transmissions: eligible primary care; protected SUD; mixed; unreliable historical labels; medication and problem lists; linked orders/results/referrals/documents/attachments; consent exception lifecycle; and medical emergency documentation. Confirm demographics match without service-affiliation leakage.
Audit, monitoring & containment
For every routine and exception release, retain rule/authority, actor, recipient, time, and data released. Review misclassification, unauthorized release, failed authorized release, and manual-exception workload. A failed segmentation test or suspected improper transmission triggers authority to suspend affected outbound routes, preserve evidence, investigate/notify under applicable process, remediate, retest, and resume only with approval.

Decision record
Approve the recommended encounter-based configuration subject to the stated compliance validation, negative-disclosure testing, and containment authority. This choice preserves clinical continuity internally, enables eligible primary-care participation externally, and fails safely where classification or authority is uncertain.

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 存在于确切的文件名下，并作为有效、未损坏的 Word 文档打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx存在于提交根目录中并且可以打开或解析。

original.criterion: The required DOCX exists under the exact filename and opens as a valid, non-corrupt Word document.
original.evidence: Submitted file and DOCX package structure.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx is present at the submission root and can be opened or parsed.

criteria.description: 渲染的文档不超过四页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准 Office 渲染器渲染 DOCX 并计算所有页面，包括标题或附录页。

original.criterion: The rendered document is no more than four pages.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard office renderer and count all pages, including title or appendix pages.

criteria.description: 该文档提出了一项明确的配置建议，而不是提出几种同等的选择。
criteria.evidence: 文档中的建议和决策语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 资深读者应该能够识别正在提出供批准的一种配置，而无需协调相互冲突的建议。

original.criterion: The document makes one unambiguous configuration recommendation rather than presenting several co-equal choices.
original.evidence: Recommendation and decision language in the document.
original.grader_hint: A senior reader should be able to identify one configuration that is being put forward for approval without reconciling conflicting recommendations.

criteria.description: 该建议保留一份内部患者图表，同时区分外部释放的内容和临床医生内部保留的内容。
criteria.evidence: 内部与出站数据处理的推荐配置和描述。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当该计划避免图表分裂并明确将内部临床可用性与交易所披露分开时才值得信赖。

original.criterion: The recommendation preserves one internal patient chart while distinguishing what is released externally from what clinicians retain internally.
original.evidence: Recommended configuration and description of internal versus outbound data handling.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if the plan avoids chart splitting and clearly separates internal clinical availability from exchange disclosure.

criteria.description: 该计划将受 SUD 严格保密控制的记录与仅与成瘾或行为健康相关的信息区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 范围、假设或控制边界的讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找可辩护的范围区别；该文件不应断言每种情况下的每项与成瘾相关的事实都自动具有相同的法律地位。

original.criterion: The plan distinguishes records subject to heightened SUD confidentiality controls from information that is merely related to addiction or behavioral health.
original.grader_hint: Look for a defensible scope distinction; the document should not assert that every addiction-related fact in every setting automatically has identical legal status.

criteria.description: 该计划将 SUD 计划的监管状态和记录来源视为与保护相关，而不是声称仅凭许可就可以最终确定覆盖范围。
criteria.evidence: 适用性假设和验证条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信谨慎的适用性声明或合规性验证门。不需要特定司法管辖区的引文。

original.criterion: The plan treats the SUD program's regulatory status and the provenance of the record as relevant to protection, rather than claiming that licensure alone conclusively determines coverage.
original.grader_hint: Credit a cautious applicability statement or compliance validation gate. Do not require a jurisdiction-specific citation.

criteria.description: 该计划声明或明确反映，使用共享 EHR 或组合图表并不会消除受保护的 SUD 记录所附加的严格保密义务。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件不得暗示技术混合使所有图表内容可以自由交换。

original.criterion: The plan states or clearly reflects that use of a shared EHR or combined chart does not extinguish heightened confidentiality obligations attached to protected SUD records.
original.grader_hint: The document must not imply that technical commingling makes all chart contents freely exchangeable.

criteria.description: 交换参与要求被视为合同或运营目标，其本身并不凌驾于患者保密要求之上。
criteria.evidence: 讨论交换承诺和治理限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果该计划在参与与合法披露之间取得平衡，并且不将合同视为独立的披露机构，则信用。

original.criterion: The exchange participation requirement is treated as a contractual or operational objective that does not itself override patient confidentiality requirements.
original.evidence: Discussion of the exchange commitment and governing constraints.
original.grader_hint: Credit if the plan balances participation with lawful disclosure and does not treat the contract as independent disclosure authority.

criteria.description: 该计划并不将健康信息交换参与协议、隐私惯例一般通知或常规治疗同意书与受保护的 SUD 披露所需的任何特定患者许可等同起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的区别或明确保留它的措辞。

original.criterion: The plan does not equate a health information exchange participation agreement, general notice of privacy practices, or routine treatment consent with any specific patient permission required for protected SUD disclosure.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit distinction or wording that unmistakably preserves it.

criteria.description: 在使用患者许可的情况下，该计划要求该许可对于预期接收者、信息、目的和持续时间有效，而不是假设一揽子同意。
criteria.evidence: 同意控制的发布工作流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 不需要精确的形式语言，但计划必须定义足够的范围，以防止无限期、不加区别的发布。

original.criterion: Where patient permission is used, the plan requires the permission to be valid for the intended recipient, information, purpose, and duration rather than assuming blanket consent.
original.grader_hint: Exact form language is not required, but the plan must define enough scope to prevent an indefinite, indiscriminate release.

criteria.description: 该计划认识到，普通的隐私控制（例如最低必要的审查）并不能独立创建披露受特殊保护的记录的权力。
criteria.evidence: 管理控制或披露决策规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果在建立授权后将最低限度的必要处理作为附加限制而不是替代授权，则信用。

original.criterion: The plan recognizes that ordinary privacy controls such as minimum-necessary review do not independently create authority to disclose specially protected records.
original.evidence: Governing controls or disclosure decision rules.
original.grader_hint: Credit if minimum-necessary handling is presented as an additional limitation after authority is established, not as a substitute for authority.

criteria.description: 关于下游使用或重新披露的声明经过适当限定，并不承诺通过交易所发送数据在技术上不可能导致滥用。
criteria.evidence: 外汇管制、接收者义务或残余风险讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件可能依赖于接收方义务和外汇管制，但它必须承认剩余风险，而不是声称绝对预防。

original.criterion: Statements about downstream use or redisclosure are appropriately qualified and do not promise that sending data through the exchange makes misuse technically impossible.
original.evidence: Exchange controls, recipient obligations, or residual-risk discussion.
original.grader_hint: The document may rely on recipient obligations and exchange controls, but it must acknowledge residual risk rather than claim absolute prevention.

criteria.description: 推荐的设计以符合规定的 EHR 限制的方式使用遭遇级别分段。
criteria.evidence: 配置描述与记录的平台功能进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 该设计必须是可实施的，而不依赖于 EHR 所缺乏的问题级或药物级细分。

original.criterion: The recommended design uses encounter-level segmentation in a way that is consistent with the stated EHR limitation.
original.evidence: Configuration description compared with the documented platform capability.
original.grader_hint: The design must be implementable without relying on problem-level or medication-level segmentation that the EHR lacks.

criteria.description: 该文件明确记录 EHR 无法分割单个问题列表或药物列表条目以进行交换。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受明确指出问题和药物数据不可用于元素级分割的等效措辞。

original.criterion: The document expressly records that the EHR cannot segment individual problem-list or medication-list entries for exchange.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent wording that clearly names both problem and medication data as unavailable for element-level segmentation.

criteria.description: 在推荐的配置下，默认情况下，受保护的 SUD 遭遇不会被排除在常规交换发布之外。
criteria.evidence: 推荐中的默认出站规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当常规放行需要适用的例外或有效的患者许可而不是自动发生时才予以评分。

original.criterion: Protected SUD encounters are excluded from routine exchange release by default under the recommended configuration.
original.evidence: Default outbound rule in the recommendation.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if routine release requires an applicable exception or valid patient permission rather than occurring automatically.

criteria.description: 符合条件的初级保健就诊在普通隐私和交换控制下仍然可以交换，而不是仅仅因为患者也使用了 SUD 服务而被自动抑制。
criteria.evidence: 初级保健遭遇的出站规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划应保留有用的初级保健参与，同时对可能揭示受保护的 SUD 治疗的数据采取任何必要的保障措施。

original.criterion: Eligible primary-care encounters remain exchangeable under ordinary privacy and exchange controls rather than being automatically suppressed solely because the patient also used the SUD service.
original.grader_hint: The plan should preserve useful primary-care participation while applying any necessary safeguards for data that could reveal protected SUD treatment.

criteria.description: 该计划为包含初级保健和受保护的 SUD 内容的遭遇提供了保守的、可操作的规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 制定一条规则，防止意外泄露，并确定随后如何解决该事件；使用判断力的模糊指示是不够的。

original.criterion: The plan supplies a conservative, operable rule for encounters containing both primary-care and protected SUD content.
original.grader_hint: Credit a rule that prevents accidental disclosure and identifies how the encounter may later be cleared; vague instructions to use judgment are insufficient.

criteria.description: 该计划可防止图表级纵向药物有效负载绕过遭遇分段并暴露 SUD 派生的药物信息。
criteria.evidence: 按照推荐的配置进行药物喂养治疗。
criteria.grader_hint: 安全措施可以抑制或以其他方式控制出站纵向有效负载，但不得删除临床医生在 EHR 内使用的统一药物清单。

original.criterion: The plan prevents a chart-level longitudinal medication payload from bypassing encounter segmentation and exposing SUD-derived medication information.
original.evidence: Medication-feed treatment in the recommended configuration.
original.grader_hint: The safeguard may suppress or otherwise control the outbound longitudinal payload, but it must not remove the unified medication list clinicians use inside the EHR.

criteria.description: 该计划解决了图表级问题列表数据的等效泄漏风险，这些数据无法按源遇到进行分段。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当计划识别并控制纵向问题列表风险时才给予信用，而不仅仅是遇到注释。

original.criterion: The plan addresses the equivalent leakage risk from chart-level problem-list data that cannot be segmented by source encounter.
original.grader_hint: Credit only if the plan identifies and controls the longitudinal problem-list risk, not merely encounter notes.

criteria.description: 配置考虑了关联的订单、结果、推荐、文档和附件，以便排除的 SUD 遭遇不会通过链接的工件公开。
criteria.grader_hint: 简洁的分组规则是可以接受的。关键是在相关内容中保留家长遭遇的保护。

original.criterion: The configuration accounts for associated orders, results, referrals, documents, and attachments so that an excluded SUD encounter is not disclosed through a linked artifact.
original.grader_hint: A concise grouped rule is acceptable. The key is preserving the parent encounter's protection across associated content.

criteria.description: 该计划处理身份和人口统计数据，而不将普通患者匹配视为公开参与 SUD 计划的许可。
criteria.evidence: 患者匹配、人口统计或元数据控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果患者身份可以支持交换操作，同时 SUD 服务隶属关系在需要时仍受到保护，则值得赞扬。

original.criterion: The plan handles identity and demographic data without treating ordinary patient matching as permission to expose participation in the SUD program.
original.grader_hint: Credit if patient identity can support exchange operations while SUD-service affiliation remains protected where required.

criteria.description: 该计划控制元数据、遭遇名称、科室名称、路由标签或警报，即使临床内容被阻止，这些也可能揭示 SUD 治疗。
criteria.grader_hint: 超越注释文本。至少一项操作控制必须解决泄露标签或元数据的问题。

original.criterion: The plan controls metadata, encounter names, department names, routing labels, or alerts that could reveal SUD treatment even when clinical content is blocked.
original.grader_hint: Look beyond note text. At least one operational control must address revealing labels or metadata.

criteria.description: 在过渡期间，不一致的历史标签和已预订的标签不被信任作为发布遭遇的唯一依据。
criteria.evidence: 过渡期分类和发布规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于验证、保留、映射或审查机制，可防止不可靠的标签驱动自动披露。

original.criterion: During the transition, inconsistent historical and already-booked labels are not trusted as the sole basis for releasing an encounter.
original.grader_hint: Credit a validation, hold, mapping, or review mechanism that prevents unreliable labels from driving automatic disclosure.

criteria.description: 过渡期过程定义了在交换传输之前无法解决分类的遭遇会发生什么情况。
criteria.evidence: 例外或未解决的分类规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 该规则应该安全失败并建立处置；仅仅说要调查是不够的。

original.criterion: The transition-period process defines what happens to an encounter whose classification cannot be resolved before exchange transmission.
original.grader_hint: The rule should fail safely and establish a disposition; merely saying to investigate is not enough.

criteria.description: 最终状态规则使用专门的 SUD 部门和遇到类型作为稳定分类控制的一部分，而不声称这些标签单独解决了每个法律范围问题。
criteria.evidence: 最终状态配置和范围限定。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果专用结构能够实现可靠的路由，同时混合或错误分类的内容仍然具有可防御的异常路径，则值得称赞。

original.criterion: The end-state rule uses the dedicated SUD department and encounter types as part of a stable classification control without claiming those labels alone settle every legal scope question.
original.grader_hint: Credit if dedicated structure enables reliable routing while mixed or misclassified content still has a defensible exception path.

criteria.description: 该计划包括针对分配了错误敏感度或部门分类的遭遇的受控纠正过程。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找更正权限以及对任何排队或已传输数据的处理。

original.criterion: The plan includes a controlled correction process for an encounter that was assigned the wrong sensitivity or department classification.
original.grader_hint: Look for both correction authority and treatment of any queued or already transmitted data.

criteria.description: 患者授权的发布被定义为具有记录范围的受控异常，而不是默认的操作模型。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划必须保留默认的分段规则，并避免依赖广泛的重复手动同意工作。

original.criterion: Patient-authorized releases are defined as controlled exceptions with a documented scope rather than as the default operating model.
original.grader_hint: The plan must preserve the default segmentation rule and avoid relying on broad recurring manual consent work.

criteria.description: 该计划在进一步发布之前解决患者许可的到期、撤销或重大变更问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果运营计划确定了如何重新验证和停止发布权限，则予以奖励；不需要详细的表单设计。

original.criterion: The plan addresses expiration, revocation, or material change of patient permission before further releases occur.
original.grader_hint: Credit if the operating plan identifies how release authority is revalidated and stopped; detailed form design is unnecessary.

criteria.description: 预期的同意工作量与规定的人员配置限制一致，因为手动处理仅限于例外情况，而不是每笔交易都需要。
criteria.evidence: 推荐的工作流程和操作假设。
criteria.grader_hint: 将基线发布路径与异常流程进行比较。设计不应该默默地重新创建被拒绝的同意重模型。

original.criterion: The expected consent workload is consistent with the stated staffing constraint because manual handling is limited to exceptions rather than required for every exchange transaction.
original.grader_hint: Compare the baseline release path with the exception process. The design should not silently recreate the rejected consent-heavy model.

criteria.description: 紧急昏迷患者病例被视为一条狭窄的医疗紧急途径，其阈值与立即治疗需求或严重伤害相关，而不是作为一般的便利例外。
criteria.grader_hint: 信贷谨慎，操作门槛高。该文件不得暗示每一个紧急请求或打破玻璃事件都授权披露。

original.criterion: The urgent unconscious-patient case is treated as a narrow medical-emergency pathway with a threshold tied to immediate treatment need or serious harm, not as a general convenience exception.
original.grader_hint: Credit a cautious, operational threshold. The document must not imply that every urgent request or break-glass event authorizes disclosure.

criteria.description: 紧急路径将披露限制为与紧急情况相关的信息，而不是自动打开完整的 SUD 记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 即使无法自动分割精确字段，也要寻找必要性和相关性限制。

original.criterion: The emergency pathway limits the disclosure to information relevant to the emergency rather than opening the complete SUD record automatically.
original.grader_hint: Look for necessity and relevance limits even if exact fields cannot be segmented automatically.

criteria.description: 紧急途径需要同时或及时记录紧急情况的依据、请求者或接收者、披露的信息、日期和授权人员。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果等效的审计要素确定了谁、什么、为什么、何时以及针对谁，那么它们是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The emergency pathway requires contemporaneous or prompt documentation of the emergency basis, requester or recipient, information disclosed, date, and authorizing actor.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent audit elements are acceptable if they establish who, what, why, when, and to whom.

criteria.description: 该计划并未声称使用技术性的玻璃破碎功能本身即可为紧急披露提供法律依据。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信访问能力和披露权限之间的明确区别。

original.criterion: The plan does not claim that use of a technical break-glass function by itself supplies legal authority for the emergency disclosure.
original.grader_hint: Credit an explicit distinction between access capability and disclosure authority.

criteria.description: 常规和例外发布会生成足以重建适用规则、参与者、接收者和披露数据的审计证据。
criteria.evidence: 审核日志记录和审查控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 一般性的说法是，除非计划将日志连接到对外披露审核，否则 EHR 日志访问是不够的。

original.criterion: Routine and exceptional releases generate audit evidence sufficient to reconstruct the applicable rule, actor, recipient, and disclosed data.
original.grader_hint: A generic statement that the EHR logs access is insufficient unless the plan connects logs to outbound disclosure review.

criteria.description: 对受保护遭遇进行分类、覆盖或释放的操作访问权限受角色限制，并与普通交换使用分开。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找指定的职能角色或决策权威，而不一定是个人名字。

original.criterion: Operational access to classify, override, or release protected encounters is restricted by role and separated from ordinary exchange use.
original.grader_hint: Look for named functional roles or decision authority, not necessarily individual names.

criteria.description: 该计划为不确定的覆盖范围或披露权限确定了合规升级点，而无需将每个常规决策转为法律审查。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信标准操作和真正不明确或高风险案例之间的可用界限。

original.criterion: The plan identifies a compliance escalation point for uncertain coverage or disclosure authority without shifting every routine decision to legal review.
original.grader_hint: Credit a usable boundary between standard operations and genuinely ambiguous or high-risk cases.

criteria.description: 分割图替代方案被明确拒绝或推迟，因为它会分散药物视图并产生临床协调或重复记录风险。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝必须将替代方案与所声明的对统一内部药物清单的依赖联系起来。

original.criterion: The split-chart alternative is explicitly rejected or deferred because it would fragment the medication view and create clinical-reconciliation or duplicate-record risk.
original.grader_hint: The rejection must connect the alternative to the stated reliance on the unified internal medication list.

criteria.description: 整个实践抑制替代方案被明确拒绝或推迟，因为它不必要地阻碍了合格的初级保健交流并破坏了参与目标。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果该计划解释了过度限制以及运营或合同后果，则予以奖励。

original.criterion: The whole-practice suppression alternative is explicitly rejected or deferred because it unnecessarily blocks eligible primary-care exchange and undermines the participation objective.
original.grader_hint: Credit if the plan explains both excessive restriction and the operational or contractual consequence.

criteria.description: 广泛的重复同意管理模型被明确拒绝或推迟，因为其手动工作量和故障点与可用的操作能力不一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 该计划可以保留对例外情况的同意，但必须解释为什么它不适合作为基线配置。

original.criterion: A broad recurring consent-management model is explicitly rejected or deferred because its manual workload and failure points are inconsistent with available operating capacity.
original.grader_hint: The plan may preserve consent for exceptions but must explain why it is unsuitable as the baseline configuration.

criteria.description: 将被拒绝的替代方案与用于证明推荐合理性的相同隐私、临床连续性、交换参与、人员配备和技术限制进行比较。
criteria.evidence: 推荐理由和替代方案比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较可以很紧凑，但必须内部一致，而不是对每个选项使用不同的未声明的标准。

original.criterion: The rejected alternatives are compared against the same privacy, clinical-continuity, exchange-participation, staffing, and technical constraints used to justify the recommendation.
original.grader_hint: The comparison can be compact, but it must be internally consistent rather than using different unstated standards for each option.

criteria.description: 该计划确定了当前状态授权的具体配置或治理变更。
criteria.evidence: 更改授权或当前到未来状态的描述。
criteria.grader_hint: 在保持不变的内容和批准允许实施团队更改的内容之间寻找可审计的区别。

original.criterion: The plan identifies the concrete configuration or governance changes authorized from the current state.
original.grader_hint: Look for an auditable distinction between what remains unchanged and what approval permits the implementation team to alter.

criteria.description: 确定实施依赖性和责任职能以进行分类、隐私批准、交换配置、临床验证和事件响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 个人姓名是不必要的。明确的职能所有权可以防止团队之间的责任分散。

original.criterion: Implementation dependencies and accountable functions are identified for classification, privacy approval, exchange configuration, clinical validation, and incident response.
original.grader_hint: Personal names are unnecessary. Credit clear functional ownership that prevents responsibilities from falling between teams.

criteria.description: 上线前验证测试允许的传输和禁止的传输，而不是仅检查连接是否有效。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试方法必须包括正面和负面的披露结果。

original.criterion: Pre-go-live validation tests both permitted transmission and prohibited transmission rather than checking only that connectivity works.
original.grader_hint: The test approach must include positive and negative disclosure outcomes.

criteria.description: 该测试集实质上涵盖了初级保健遭遇、SUD 遭遇、混合遭遇、不可靠的历史标签、纵向药物或问题数据、同意例外和紧急路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 等效的合并情景是可以接受的，但每个列出的风险必须在批准之前进行行使。

original.criterion: The test set materially covers primary-care encounters, SUD encounters, mixed encounters, unreliable historical labels, longitudinal medication or problem data, consent exceptions, and the emergency pathway.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent consolidated scenarios are acceptable, but each listed risk must be exercised before approval.

criteria.description: 该计划为失败的分段测试或可疑的不当传输提供遏制或回滚响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求暂停或遏制权力、调查和受控恢复，而不是稍后解决问题的不受支持的承诺。

original.criterion: The plan provides a containment or rollback response for a failed segmentation test or suspected improper transmission.
original.grader_hint: Look for suspension or containment authority, investigation, and controlled resumption rather than an unsupported promise to fix issues later.

criteria.description: 上线后监控可以检测错误分类、未经授权的发布、授权发布失败以及手动异常工作量的增长。
criteria.grader_hint: 不需要确切的数字目标，但措施必须涵盖隐私泄露、临床可用性和运营可持续性。

original.criterion: Post-go-live monitoring can detect misclassification, unauthorized release, failed authorized release, and growth in manual exception workload.
original.grader_hint: Exact numeric targets are not required, but the measures must cover privacy leakage, clinical availability, and operational sustainability.

criteria.description: 预计的过渡期结果是根据关于不可靠标签、分阶段转换和有限的人工能力的明确假设得出的。
criteria.grader_hint: 预测可能是定性的。它应该预见到在过渡期间会有更多的保留或审查，而不会发明不受支持的卷。

original.criterion: Projected transition-period outcomes follow from explicitly stated assumptions about unreliable labels, staged conversion, and constrained manual capacity.
original.grader_hint: The projection may be qualitative. It should anticipate more holds or reviews during transition without inventing unsupported volumes.

criteria.description: 预计的最终状态结果遵循专门的部门和遭遇类型结构，并承认混合内容和不可分割的纵向数据的残余风险。
criteria.evidence: 最终状态假设和预计效果。
criteria.grader_hint: 最终状态可能会提高可靠性，但文件不得声称标签消除了所有隐私或泄露风险。

original.criterion: Projected end-state outcomes follow from the dedicated department and encounter-type structure and acknowledge residual risk from mixed content and non-segmentable longitudinal data.
original.grader_hint: The end state may improve reliability, but the document must not claim that labels eliminate all privacy or leakage risk.

criteria.description: 该计划避免了有关患者数量、人员配备、成本、错误率或系统性能的无依据的数字声明，并将任何未给出的假设标记为假设。
criteria.evidence: 所有定量和预测性陈述。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查表格和标注以及散文。简报中提供的日期可能会重复；发明的操作数据不应作为事实呈现。

original.criterion: The plan avoids unsupported numeric claims about patient volume, staffing, cost, error rates, or system performance and labels any non-given assumptions as assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Review tables and callouts as well as prose. Dates supplied in the brief may be repeated; invented operational figures should not be presented as facts.

criteria.description: 该文档简洁、易于导航、内部一致，可供执行审批者和实施或合规领导使用，而无需要求作者解决重大歧义。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估是否可以找到建议、规则、例外、所有权和批准后果并采取行动。技术上正确但模糊或不切实际的工作不应获得满分。

original.criterion: The document is concise, navigable, internally consistent, and usable by an executive approver and implementation or compliance leads without asking the author to resolve a material ambiguity.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the recommendation, rules, exceptions, ownership, and approval consequences can be located and acted on. Technically correct but ambiguous or impractical work should not receive full credit.

spec.professional_context: Peatmoor Analytics is preparing Ivyhurst Studios’ integrated primary-care and SUD service for participation in a health information exchange. The operating plan will support an executive configuration decision with significant privacy, clinical-safety, contractual, and implementation consequences.
difficulty_sources: Choosing one workable configuration despite competing privacy, clinical-continuity, exchange-participation, and staffing constraints
Applying heightened SUD confidentiality principles without enough facts to make an unconditional legal coverage determination
Designing around encounter-only segmentation and non-segmentable longitudinal medication and problem data
Creating controls that differ appropriately between an unstable transition period and the end state
Separating a rare medical-emergency pathway from routine disclosure guidance
Producing defensible qualitative outcome projections without inventing operational figures

authoring_plan.solver_instance: A medical and health services manager with responsibility for privacy-sensitive exchange operations must create an executive-ready operating plan from occupational knowledge, without source files or live research.
authoring_plan.behaviour_specification: The solution should make one conservative but workable call: retain the unified internal chart; allow eligible primary-care encounters to flow; suppress protected SUD encounters from routine exchange; control non-segmentable longitudinal medication and problem payloads so they cannot bypass encounter segmentation; use narrowly governed patient-authorized and medical-emergency release pathways; and treat uncertain or mixed records as restricted until resolved.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: Approve the encounter-based configuration subject to documented compliance applicability validation, negative disclosure testing, and controlled transition safeguards. Reject chart splitting, whole-practice suppression, and broad recurring consent management as baseline designs.
imperfections_and_tensions: Primary care and the licensed SUD service share one EHR and one chart.
The EHR can segregate outbound data only by encounter, not by individual problem or medication entry.
The unified internal medication list is clinically important and must not be destroyed to solve the exchange problem.
The SUD service is moving from shared scheduling templates to dedicated departments and encounter types over eight weeks.
Historical and already-booked encounters have inconsistent labels, so automatic release based solely on current labels would be unsafe during transition.
Manual consent operations can support exceptions but cannot sustainably govern every exchange event.
The medical-emergency case is rare but must be separately governed because routine guidance is insufficient and misuse could cause severe privacy harm.
Licensure and addiction-related content do not, by themselves, provide enough facts for a categorical legal coverage conclusion.
gold_relationships: Routine release eligibility must depend on encounter provenance, classification reliability, applicable disclosure authority, and the absence of linked protected content.
Protected SUD encounters are withheld by default; valid patient permission or a narrow applicable exception may authorize a controlled release.
Eligible primary-care encounters remain exchangeable unless their content or linked artifacts would reveal protected SUD treatment.
Mixed encounters and unresolved classifications fail closed until reviewed or corrected.

During transition, historical or inconsistent labels require validation, mapping, or a release hold; after transition, dedicated department and encounter types become the primary routing control but not an absolute legal conclusion.

Outbound chart-level medication and problem payloads must not be allowed to expose entries whose protected provenance cannot be separated. Internal clinician access to the unified list remains intact.
Orders, results, referrals, notes, attachments, and revealing metadata inherit or are reconciled with the protection of the originating encounter.
Patient permission is scoped, documented, time-bound as applicable, and subject to lifecycle controls; it is an exception workflow rather than the baseline architecture.

The medical-emergency pathway requires a treatment-linked serious-harm threshold, disclosure limited to relevant information, authorized action, and documentation of who, what, why, when, and to whom.
A technical break-glass capability permits access but does not itself establish disclosure authority.

The split-chart option fails the clinical-continuity test; whole-practice suppression fails the proportionality and exchange-participation test; broad recurring consent management fails the staffing and reliability test.

Transition projections should anticipate more holds and manual validation because labels are unreliable. End-state projections should anticipate more consistent routing but retain residual risks from mixed content and non-segmentable longitudinal data.
Go-live approval depends on positive and negative transmission tests, including linked artifacts and longitudinal feeds, with containment authority for failures.
The authorized change description must identify the new encounter-routing, feed-suppression, exception, audit, and governance controls while preserving the internal unified chart.

doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.rule: Heightened confidentiality may attach to qualifying SUD program records and follow the record into a shared system.
doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.must_not_claim: Every addiction-related fact or every record created by a licensed service automatically has identical status without an applicability analysis.

doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.rule: Exchange disclosure requires applicable authority and compliance with governing confidentiality controls.
doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.must_not_claim: The exchange contract, routine treatment consent, or technical connectivity independently authorizes all disclosures.

doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.rule: Minimum-necessary and role-based controls remain relevant after disclosure authority is established.
doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.must_not_claim: Applying minimum-necessary review creates authority that otherwise does not exist.

doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.rule: Patient-authorized disclosure must be governed according to its valid scope and lifecycle.
doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.must_not_claim: One blanket or indefinite consent automatically covers every recipient, purpose, and future disclosure.

doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.rule: A narrow medical-emergency pathway may be available when its substantive conditions are met.
doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.must_not_claim: Any urgent request, unconscious patient, or use of break-glass automatically permits release of the complete record.

doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.rule: Recipient obligations, exchange controls, and audit evidence can reduce downstream risk.
doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.must_not_claim: Segmentation or exchange participation makes unauthorized downstream use technically impossible.

doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.rule: Dedicated departments and encounter types improve classification and routing reliability.
doctrinal_rule_and_nonclaim_pairs.must_not_claim: A department label conclusively determines legal coverage or eliminates mixed-content risk.

authoring_plan.reachability_check: All rubric requirements are assessable from the single DOCX and derive from the stated operational facts or standard healthcare privacy, records-management, clinical-safety, and HIE implementation practice. No item depends on a hidden local code, vendor-specific screen, external source, exact case count, or undisclosed numeric answer. A four-page document can satisfy the rubric through a concise recommendation, configuration rules, transition and exception controls, alternatives comparison, implementation controls, and assumptions.

deliverables.description: Executive operating plan recommending a data-segmentation configuration, defining transition and end-state operation, and documenting rejected alternatives.
constraints: Must be written to the top level of the working directory using the exact filename exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx.
Must not exceed four rendered pages.
Must present one recommended configuration and identify the authorized changes from the current configuration.
Must address both the eight-week transition and the end state.
Must address the rare urgent request involving an unconscious patient.
Must not invent unsupported patient volumes, staffing levels, costs, system capabilities, or definitive legal conclusions.
Must not be an EHR click-through guide.

title_original: peatmoor ivyhurst sud exchange segmentation plan
original_instruction:
You are the medical operations manager at Peatmoor Analytics, which manages Ivyhurst Studios’ co-located primary-care practice and licensed substance-use-disorder service. Estelle Calderon needs an approval-ready operating plan for joining the regional health information exchange in October without exposing records the service treats as specially protected. Both services use one EHR and one patient chart. The platform can segregate outbound data only at the encounter level; it cannot selectively remove individual problems or medications, and clinicians rely on the unified internal medication list. Splitting the chart would disrupt that clinical view, walling off the whole practice would undermine the exchange commitment, and a consent-heavy model would exceed the team’s capacity for recurring manual review. The practice is also mid-change: over the next eight weeks, the SUD service is moving from shared scheduling templates to dedicated departments and encounter types, while historical and already-booked encounters will retain inconsistent labels. The plan therefore has to work during that transition as well as after the new structure is established. There is also a rare but high-consequence case to cover: another treating facility may urgently request relevant SUD information for an unconscious patient when delay could create serious harm and ordinary consent cannot be obtained. Prepare one recommended segmentation configuration, explain the material privacy and operational boundaries, identify the changes authorized from the current configuration, and set aside the credible alternatives. Include the assumptions behind your projection of transition-period and end-state outcomes, but do not invent patient volumes, staffing levels, costs, system capabilities, or legal conclusions that the facts do not support. This is for an executive decision, not a legal brief or an EHR click-through guide, and it must be usable by the implementation and compliance leads after approval. Keep it to four pages maximum. Write the final document into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx`.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx` — Executive operating plan recommending a data-segmentation configuration, defining transition and end-state operation, and documenting rejected alternatives. (Must be written to the top level of the working directory using the exact filename exchange_segmentation_operating_plan.docx.; Must not exceed four rendered pages.; Must present one recommended configuration and identify the authorized changes from the current configuration.; Must address both the eight-week transition and the end state.; Must address the rare urgent request involving an unconscious patient.; Must not invent unsupported patient volumes, staffing levels, costs, system capabilities, or definitive legal conclusions.; Must not be an EHR click-through guide.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
